ART-ANC-HUMAN.identity: A Human adventurer, medium-sized, the plain short-lived 'striver' people who persist where steadier peoples fail, shown as a traveller in a Bastion's service.
ART-ANC-HUMAN.composition: Full figure in three-quarter view mid-stride along a rutted road, walking staff planted ahead, head turned back over the shoulder toward unseen pursuit.
details: Layered road clothes: patched tunic, belted over-coat, hooded mantle pushed back
Walking staff of plain ash, scuffed iron ferrule
Short sword in a worn scabbard at the left hip
Travel pack with bedroll and tin cup lashed on
Ordinary unremarkable face, stubble, weathered skin, determined set jaw
Mud-caked boots and frayed hem
No horns, fur, scales or pointed ears: wholly ordinary proportions
ART-ANC-HUMAN.atmosphere: Plain weathered resolve, a small life walking through a vast dying land.
avoid: No exotic features: the Human must look unmarked beside the other ancestries
No armour plate or heroic pose: this is a traveller, not a Fighter
Do not copy the Elf's long cloak or the Halfling's hood
sources: 6.9 Ancestries: Human

Leather sling with a round stone, other stones in a belt pouch

Bare, hairy-topped feet or light soft boots
Wall coursing and weeds that show the small scale
Wary but calm expression

No pointed ears (that is Elf/Gnome territory)
Do not stand it beside nothing; the wall must show it is small
No sword: its kit is sling, pack and pot
sources: 6.9 Ancestries: Halfling

Do not give it a greataxe (that is the Orc adventurer's kit)

ART-ANC-ELF.identity: An Elf adventurer, medium-sized, tall and lean, a graceful, long-memoried traveller in a Bastion's service.

No heavy armour

Keep proportions grounded, not toy-like

ART-CLA-RANGER.identity: A Ranger, Hybrid class: ground-reader and strike-from-distance hunter; packages of Shortbow, Elven Dagger, Elven Spear, Hide Cuirass, Snares.

ART-CLA-PALADIN.identity: A Paladin, Hybrid class: bearer of an unbending oath; packages of Mace, Longsword, Targe, Ring Shirt, Quarterstaff, Gambeson.

ART-CLA-WIZARD.identity: A Wizard, Caster class: scholar of rebuilt power; packages of Quarterstaff, Magnifying Glass, Torches, Elven Dagger, Sling, Scroll of Arcane Bolt.

Dagger sheathed at the belt

ART-CLA-TRICKSTER.identity: A Trickster, Hybrid class: shaper of belief and illusion; packages of Elven Rapier, Shortbow, Elven Dagger, Smokestick, Caltrops, Lockpicks.

Smokestick burning at the belt, thin wisp rising

ART-CLA-SORCERER.identity: A Sorcerer, Caster class: carrier of unasked-for power; packages of Quarterstaff, Dagger, Sling, Gambeson, Bandages.
ART-CLA-SORCERER.composition: Full figure in three-quarter view bracing against its own power, one arm extended with a palm facing the viewer and a small crackling arc of ink-drawn lightning, the other hand clamping the bandaged forearm.
details: Bandaged forearms, old scars and fresh dressings
Hair and cloak flung back by unseen wind
Plain gambeson, torn sleeve
Sling and dagger at belt
Wide eyes with solid-black pupils and a thin white ring

Lightning rendered as sharp black zigzag strokes, not glow

ART-CLA-DRUID.identity: A Druid, Caster class: servant of the world's slow reclamation; packages of Quarterstaff, Club, Wooden Shield, Sling, Elven Sickle, Leather Coat.
ART-CLA-DRUID.composition: Full figure in three-quarter view standing barefoot in tall grass, staff planted in one hand and the other palm open and low, a crow perched on the staff head.

Quarterstaff carved with root-like twists
Sprig crown of leaves and a few small twigs in the hair
Sickle at the belt
Bare feet in grass, vines curling round the staff
Weather-lined face, calm eyes

No glowing magic

ART-TRA-TIER-1-ARCANE-SPELLS-D20.identity: Tier 1 Arcane Spells: the first lessons of any surviving academy (Arcane Bolt, Burning Hands, Ice Ray, Force Push, Phase Step).

Practice post with chopped and scorched marks
Small flame drawn as a single clean ink flame cupped in the palm
Air distortion drawn as bent parallel lines before the other palm
Training yard with cracked flagstones and a rack of straw targets
Anxious concentrated face, tongue-tip between teeth
A battered wooden staff leaning on the post
ART-TRA-TIER-1-ARCANE-SPELLS-D20.atmosphere: Nervous promise, academy ruin in the background.
avoid: No lettering on tome pages or scrolls: marks only as abstract scribble
Not a grown Wizard: young, small and unsure
No big fireball or lightning
sources: 8. Powers and Traditions: 8.3 Arcane Spells, Tier 1

ART-TRA-TIER-2-ARCANE-SPELLS-D20.identity: Tier 2 Arcane Spells: wartime spells copied from libraries since burned (Fireball, Haste, Blink, Sleep, Dispel).
ART-TRA-TIER-2-ARCANE-SPELLS-D20.composition: A wizard hurriedly copying a spell from a scorched tome by candlelight while the library behind burns; wide interior view, wizard in the foreground.

Scorched open tome with charred edges and unreadable marks
Tall bookshelves in the rear shown burning in tall ink flames and black smoke
Falling embers drawn as stipples
Spilled ink pot and loose pages
Arched vaulted ceiling cracked
Face lit from one side, sweating, wide eyes
avoid: No lettering on tome pages or scrolls: marks only as abstract scribble
Do not draw a spell effect from the wizard
Keep the fire behind the figure, not on it
sources: 8. Powers and Traditions: 8.3 Arcane Spells, Tier 2

ART-TRA-TIER-3-ARCANE-SPELLS-D20.identity: Tier 3 Arcane Spells: the spells the towers killed to keep (Meteor Impact, Disintegrate, Time Break, Reality Warp).

details: Standing wizard in tattered robes, one hand holding a sealed book bound with chains and a lock
Robed corpses sprawled on a fractured mosaic floor
Drifting ash and ink-scrap pieces
Broken stair and a collapsed vault
Burned shelf and a toppled orrery frame
Wary glance upward at the broken roof
Light from the broken roof in hard diagonal hatch
ART-TRA-TIER-3-ARCANE-SPELLS-D20.atmosphere: Grim scavenger's triumph over a tomb of scholars.
avoid: No lettering on tome pages or scrolls: marks only as abstract scribble
No gore or visible wounds on the corpses
Do not make the wizard heroic
sources: 8. Powers and Traditions: 8.3 Arcane Spells, Tier 3

ART-TRA-TIER-1-DIVINE-PRAYERS-D20.identity: Tier 1 Divine Prayers: plain mercies (Sacred Flame, Guiding Light, Healing Touch, Blessing, Sanctuary).
ART-TRA-TIER-1-DIVINE-PRAYERS-D20.composition: A priest raising a lantern whose light falls on a wounded soldier, the wound visibly knitting closed; mid-shot, both figures in a ruined chapel aisle.
details: Priest in a plain habit with a hooded head, lantern held high
Soldier seated against a column, bandaged arm in lantern light
Wound drawn as a long line fading to fine hairlines
Cone of light drawn with sparse straight radiating strokes
Broken pews and a cracked altar rail
Dust motes as stippling
Weary but tender expressions

No lettering on the lantern
No visible gore

ART-TRA-TIER-2-DIVINE-PRAYERS-D20.identity: Tier 2 Divine Prayers: prayers answered less often and at greater cost (Radiant Burst, Circle of Protection, Guardian Angel, Benediction).
ART-TRA-TIER-2-DIVINE-PRAYERS-D20.composition: A weary cleric kneeling at a cracked roadside shrine beside a ledger of offerings, candles guttering; low side view.
details: Kneeling cleric, hood back, head bowed
Cracked stone shrine with a toppled statue
Open ledger with abstract ruled lines on a flat stone
Row of guttering candles and a few coins in a dish
Roadside weeds and dusk sky with sparse hatching
Satchel and travel-worn boots
Rain streaks beginning
avoid: No lettering on tome pages or scrolls: marks only as abstract scribble
No visible deity or angel
No spell effects
sources: 8. Powers and Traditions: 8.4 Divine Prayers, Tier 2

ART-TRA-TIER-3-DIVINE-PRAYERS-D20.identity: Tier 3 Divine Prayers: prayers demanded rather than asked (Divine Wrath, Heaven's Spear, Resurrection Light, Sunburst).
ART-TRA-TIER-3-DIVINE-PRAYERS-D20.composition: A priest with arms raised on a hilltop, demanding, as a vast ambiguous shape takes form in the storm clouds above; low angle looking up.
details: Small silhouette on a barren hilltop, robes whipped by wind

Storm clouds drawn as dense swirling crosshatch
A vast, ambiguous form in the clouds: shoulders, perhaps a hand, not a clear face
Beams of sparse straight lines breaking from the cloud

Tiny discarded staff at the priest's feet
avoid: Do not resolve the cloud shape into a clear god or angel
No lettering or symbol
Do not make the priest triumphant

ART-TRA-TIER-1-SORCERIES-D20.identity: Tier 1 Sorceries: cheap blood workings that never fail (Chaos Bolt, Bloodspark, Scorch Step, Ember Net).

Drops of blood rising as small black teardrops
A spark of ink-drawn jagged lines at the apex
Old scars across the wrist and forearm
Thin bandage strip unwound
A bit of the sorcerer's jaw and shadow at edge
Plain sleeve rolled to the elbow

No glowing wash
Do not show a face fully

ART-TRA-TIER-2-SORCERIES-D20.identity: Tier 2 Sorceries: the price climbs with the power (Volatile Fireball, Chain Shock, Stormskin, Shardstorm).

ART-TRA-TIER-3-SORCERIES-D20.identity: Tier 3 Sorceries: workings that do not care whether the caster survives (Catastrophe Sphere, Gravity Collapse, Ashen Vortex, Meteor Line).

Pained, resigned face

Keep villagers small and praying, not fleeing
No glow wash

ART-TRA-TIER-1-DRUIDIC-RITUALS-D20.identity: Tier 1 Druidic Rituals: small agreements with root, weather and beast (Thorn Dart, Entangling Roots, Regrowth, Fog Bank).

ART-TRA-TIER-2-DRUIDIC-RITUALS-D20.identity: Tier 2 Druidic Rituals: speaking the wild's language (Wall of Vines, Spike Growth, Summon Dire Wolf, Wild Dominion).

ART-MON-BEASTMAN.identity: Beastman, Greenmark Minion, medium: a hunched man-shape topped with the head of a goat or boar, black claws, a forest-edge warband raider.

ART-MON-SATYR-REVELER.identity: Satyr Reveler, Greenmark Controller, medium: a goat-legged laurel-crowned fey piper whose music floods listeners with terror or lulls them.
